description: Create a vehicle maintenance tracking spreadsheet. In row 1, add headers: 'Date', 'Service Type', 'Mileage', 'Cost ($)'. Add at least 5 maintenance records with realistic data (e.g., oil changes, tire rotations, brake service). Below the data, create summary calculations: Total Cost using =SUM() formula, Average Cost using =AVERAGE() formula, and Highest Single Cost using =MAX() formula. Each formula should reference the Cost column. Save the spreadsheet as vehicle_maintenance_log.xlsx in /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/.
